Features.Title: Easier cash entry and readable grids
Features.Description: Shift Cash Drop and Cash On Hand keep readable columns with horizontal scrolling. Buttons stay visible, amount fields select their existing value, and shifts can be typed or picked from a batch list. Use Newest First, Oldest First or batch search to organize shifts.

Features.Title: Invoice Inbox and review
Features.Description: Purchases now has Invoice Inbox for Gmail connection, your store invoice address and import results. Review uncertain or scanned invoices before saving. Google sign-in remains subject to Google account access requirements.

Features.Title: Safer invoice and price imports
Features.Description: Duplicate invoice checks cover the full store history. Invoice and product-price updates save together. Price comparisons distinguish packaging, and older backfills do not replace newer prices.

Features.Title: Administrator account controls
Features.Description: Administrators can edit names, roles and permitted stores, reset passwords, or deactivate and reactivate accounts. Only unused accounts can be deleted; the last active administrator is protected.

Features.Title: Sync health and retained backups
Features.Description: Use Sync Health to see the latest import, pending drops, sync results and last off-device backup. Verified backups now retain seven local copies per database in addition to the existing cloud backup. Developer sync setup remains protected.
